7d4ea15a5656e240.description: About Power Cogeneration Plant Company (PCPC) Power Cogeneration Plant Company (PCPC) is a joint venture established by Saudi Aramco, Marubeni Corporation, JGC, and Al-Jomaih. PCPC's primary objective is to provide Saudi Aramco with reliable electricity and steam through the development and operation of three cogeneration plants located in Abqaiq, Hawiyah, and Ras Tanura in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia. As an energy infrastructure company, PCPC focuses on safety, operational excellence, and long-term development. The Role of Administration & Government Relations Officer The Administration & Government Relations Officer supports daily administration, government relations, and human resources activities. This role ensures efficient office operations, timely government transactions, accurate employee records, and compliance with company policies and applicable regulations. The position is full-time and based in Buqayq and Ras Tannurah, Saudi Arabia, requiring 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Coordinate daily administrative activities, office services, facilities maintenance, and general operational requirements. Support procurement activities, vendor coordination, contract administration, and service delivery. Maintain administrative records, documentation, and office-related systems. Organize company gatherings and events. Work closely with the Aramco Security Department to facilitate the issuance of identification cards for staff members. Process and follow up on government transactions, permits, licenses, and regulatory requirements. Maintain and update company and employee information on government platforms such as Qiwa, Muqeem, and GOSI. Coordinate with government authorities to facilitate timely completion of official transactions. Maintain employee records, update HR systems, and prepare employment-related documents. Support recruitment, onboarding, employee orientation, and offboarding activities. Handle routine employee inquiries, HR requests, and employee service transactions. Support monthly payroll preparation and coordinate employee training activities. Implement applicable HR and administrative policies, procedures, and internal controls. Ensure compliance with Saudi Labor Law, government regulations, and company requirements. Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of employee and company information. Required Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in administration, government relations, or human resources. Demonstrated ability to coordinate daily administrative activities and office services. Experience with government transaction processing and regulatory compliance. Proficiency in maintaining accurate records and documentation. Familiarity with HR operations, including employee records and payroll support. Key Performance Indicators Timely completion of government transactions and renewals. Accuracy and completeness of employee and administrative records. Timely resolution of HR and administrative requests. Compliance with company policies and government regulations. Timely submission of HR and administration reports. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time Administration & Government Relations Officer position are encouraged to apply.

7d762e157c86faed.description: About Kitchenara Kitchenara operates as a video-first commerce platform dedicated to supporting restaurants in Saudi Arabia by leveraging creators. The platform facilitates the creation of short, authentic dish videos, linking each video to actual restaurant visits and orders. Kitchenara currently partners with over 270 restaurants and 2,000 creators in Riyadh. The Role of Creator Manager The Creator Manager is responsible for overseeing the creator ecosystem within Kitchenara. This full-time, on-site role in Riyadh involves managing creator recruitment, video quality, and the effectiveness of creator-driven customer engagement for partner restaurants. The individual in this position will serve as a key point of contact for creators, restaurants, and internal teams. Key Responsibilities Identify, evaluate, and onboard food creators across Riyadh, ranging from micro-creators to established figures. Match creators with appropriate restaurants and campaigns. Develop clear briefs and review videos prior to publication to ensure content is on-brand, authentic, and appealing. Provide direct and constructive feedback to creators on video hooks, filming techniques, and storytelling. Monitor creator performance metrics, including views, visits, and orders, and implement strategies to enhance performance. Manage multiple campaigns concurrently, ensuring adherence to deadlines, payment schedules, and quality standards. Organize creator meetups, tastings, and activations to foster community engagement. Collaborate with marketing, operations, and product teams to streamline and improve the creator experience. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. Work Environment and Impact This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the development of the creator side of a growing Saudi foodtech startup. The Creator Manager will work directly with founders who have experience scaling companies such as HungerStation and Careem. The position provides direct ownership and visible impact, with work directly influencing restaurant results on a weekly basis.

7db0201868f6623f.description: About the Role ARIS is seeking an Associate Account Executive for an entry-level, full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves working closely with the senior sales team to learn consultative, value-based selling strategies, focusing on enterprise deals with major regional banks. The Associate Account Executive will manage the initial stages of the sales cycle and progressively take on more responsibilities as skills develop. This position is subject to Saudi Arabia's Saudization (Nitaqat) regulations, requiring candidates to meet specific eligibility criteria. Key Responsibilities Research and identify target organizations within the territory, and map key decision-makers. Conduct outbound prospecting activities through calls, email, LinkedIn, and events to schedule initial meetings and build a qualified pipeline. Develop in-depth knowledge of ARIS solutions, including Business Process Analysis (BPA), Process Mining, and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC). Participate in discovery calls and client meetings to understand client processes, risk management, compliance, and enterprise architecture, identifying areas where ARIS solutions can add value. Provide support to senior Account Executives on proposals, product demonstrations, and deal follow-up. Maintain accurate CRM records and report on activity and pipeline to sales leadership. Stay informed on trends in process management, process mining, internal control, and audit to facilitate credible client conversations. Required Qualifications Up to 2 years of experience in sales, business development, consulting, or a client-facing role. Internships are considered relevant experience. Strong recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Demonstrated interest in enterprise technology and the operational structures of large organizations. Proactive drive for prospecting and comfort initiating conversations with new contacts. Clear and confident communication skills, both in writing and in person. Curiosity combined with the discipline to quickly learn complex solutions.

7ddb6751c9b4d5e6.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Senior Security Supervisor to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is open exclusively to Saudi Nationals and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The Senior Security Supervisor is responsible for maintaining a secure environment across the property, ensuring guest and employee safety, and responding to various security and emergency situations. Key Responsibilities Patrol all areas of the property, secure rooms, and assist guests with room access. Conduct emergency response drills, daily physical hazard/safety inspections, investigations, interviews, and key control audits. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions (CCTV) and alarm systems. Authorize, monitor, and document access to secured areas. Assist guests and employees during emergency situations, respond to accidents, contact EMS, or administer first aid/CPR as required. Gather information, complete reports, maintain confidentiality of reports/documents, and release information to authorized individuals. Defuse disturbances in accordance with company policies and procedures, resolve safety hazard situations, and handle all interruptions and complaints. Escort unwelcome persons from the property and ensure compliance with alcoholic beverage control laws. Call for assistance using proper code responses and provide appropriate paperwork to employees. Operational Duties and Standards Assist management in training, motivating, and coaching employees. Serve as a role model and first point of contact for the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to the manager. Complete safety training and certifications, ensuring uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipating and addressing their service needs, and thanking them with genuine appreciation. Communicate using clear and professional language, preparing and reviewing written documents accurately and completely, and answering telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, supporting the team to reach common goals, and listening and responding appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Physical Requirements and Work Environment Ability to read and visually verify information in various formats (*, small print) and visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines to identify defects. Proficiency in entering and locating work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Capability to move at a speed required to respond to work situations (*, run, walk, jog), and stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Skill in grasping, turning, and manipulating objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Capacity to move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces, over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, and up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Ability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 2-5 years of experience in a security-related role. Saudi Nationality is a mandatory requirement for this position. Some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position.

7d05154e15c3ac56.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة هاردل يونيتد إنفراستركتشر عن أمين مستودع فني للانضمام إلى فريقها في رابغ، مكة المكرمة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويركز على إدارة عمليات المستودع بكفاءة لضمان استلام وتخزين وصرف المواد والمعدات الفنية وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد الواردة إلى المستودع، ومطابقة كمياتها ومواصفاتها، وتخزينها بما يتناسب مع طبيعتها ويضمن حفظها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. تحديد وتأمين الأدوات والمستلزمات والأجهزة والمعدات الضرورية لسير العمل بفعالية، بما يتماشى مع السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. إعداد مذكرات استلام المعدات والأجهزة الفنية من الشركات المتخصصة. صرف الطلبات الواردة من الجهات المختصة بموجب المستندات النظامية، وتجهيز وشحن الأجهزة وقطع الغيار إلى الجهات الرسمية الطالبة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المستودعات أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على مطابقة المواصفات والكميات بدقة. معرفة جيدة بسياسات وإجراءات تخزين المواد والمعدات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية ممتازة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتوثيق العمليات. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المحددة. بيئة العمل يعمل أمين المستودع الفني ضمن فريق شركة هاردل يونيتد إنفراستركتشر في مدينة رابغ بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المستودع لإدارة العمليات اليومية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

7d772b8ed2d33963.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب المتميزون للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس ضبط وتحكم في الجودة للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير وعمليات الجودة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان تحقيق أعلى مستويات الجودة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم معايير الجودة الخاصة بالمشروعات الهندسية والإشراف على تطبيقها بفعالية. إعداد تقارير دورية ومفصلة حول أداء المشاريع الهندسية والمراحل القادمة الهامة. مقارنة التقدم الفعلي للمشاريع مع الخطط الموضوعة، وتحليل أي ثغرات أو انحرافات، وتوضيح المخاطر المحتملة. تطوير وتحسين أساليب وإجراءات العمل باستمرار، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال ضبط الجودة. إعداد وتوثيق التقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتحديد نسب التقدم، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ضبط وتحكم الجودة ضمن المشاريع الهندسية. فهم عميق لمعايير وعمليات الجودة الهندسية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم تقارير واضحة ومفصلة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مكتب المتميزون للاستشارات الهندسية بجدة، مكة المكرمة. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة داعمة تركز على تحقيق التميز في المشاريع الهندسية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذا الدور إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

7d1345162ba45ae0.description: About the Role Haji Husein Alireza & Co. Ltd. is seeking a Parts Sales Representative to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves meeting customer parts requirements, achieving sales targets, and maintaining the company's professional image through effective communication and customer handling. Key Responsibilities Meet and understand customer parts requirements, arranging supply on or before the agreed time. Achieve sales targets as agreed upon with management. Maintain the company’s professional image through effective communication and handling of all customer interactions. Ensure regularity and punctuality in daily attendance and availability at the workplace. Approach parts customers with a friendly greeting and warm reception, both in person and over the phone. Identify customer parts requirements and execute orders according to company pricing terms. Complete all required customer or job card data to generate quotations and invoices. Address customer parts requirements and escalate to the Parts Supervisor or Operations Manager when necessary. Ensure all invoiced items match the customer’s purchase order or workshop requisition, and that all supplied parts are correct according to the invoice. Handle parts returns according to company policies and procedures, including warranty claims. Maintain and monitor customers’ back-order data and follow up until parts are supplied. Ensure all pending and open job cards are closed within the stipulated time. Follow up with customers regarding pending quotations and update the system for tracking and sales analysis. Ensure all advance payments received from customers are supported by receipt vouchers. Deliver cash and credit transactions to company collectors (for 1S Branch team). Arrange proper stock receiving according to company binning procedures and inform the supervisor of any discrepancies or damages (for 1S Branch team). Utilize available company resources to maximize profitability. Maintain records of all invoices and credit notes according to company policies. Ensure the sales area is always neat and clean. Ensure customers understand HHA after-sales procedures and policies. Assist in daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly stock checks to ensure accurate and updated stock records. Adhere to all company policies and procedures. Assist the Parts Supervisor, Parts Branch Manager, and Parts Operations Manager in development projects. Ensure awareness and compliance with ISO requirements at the location. Provide coverage during the supervisor’s annual vacation. Ensure compliance with safety procedures while on duty. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. Work Environment and Conditions This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah. The role requires consistent interaction with customers and adherence to company operational standards and safety procedures. Application Process Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

7d079f596077328a.job_title: Manager IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
7d079f596077328a.company_name: Ma'aden - Saudi Arabian Mining Company | معادن
7d079f596077328a.description: About the Role Maaden is seeking a Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence to lead technical excellence in infrastructure across its sites. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves translating approved IT direction into reliable, scalable infrastructure and reusable capabilities. The Manager will enable IT Services Delivery to operate and support services effectively, while ensuring day-to-day operations and enterprise strategy ownership remain with accountable teams. Key Responsibilities Manage the infrastructure Center of Excellence for networks, systems, datacenters, and databases. Provide technical requirements, design assurance, engineering guidance, and knowledge transfer, aligned with enterprise architecture and approved priorities. Develop infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps within enterprise architecture principles. Define technical specifications and acceptance criteria for infrastructure solutions and sourcing. Govern technology selection, standard configurations, and lifecycle plans, including upgrades, refresh, and retirement. Assess emerging technologies for business fit, interoperability, capacity, and supportability. Maintain design documentation, configuration baselines, and engineering procedures. Govern and oversee infrastructure projects within delegated authority, coordinating with PMO and IT Services Delivery. Review supplier deliverables against agreed specifications and standards. Coordinate design assurance, testing, and operational handover with IT Services Delivery. Verify that designs address integration, availability, capacity, recovery, and maintainability before transition. Assess suppliers’ technical deliverables and engineering quality against agreed requirements. Define and monitor infrastructure service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs). Develop infrastructure automation and DevOps engineering practices with delivery teams. Coach technical staff, share reusable designs, and strengthen internal engineering capability. Develop capacity and lifecycle recommendations using utilization, availability, and technology requirements. Evaluate infrastructure options for standardization, reuse, and cost efficiency. Provide technical input to procurement, project estimates, and purchase requisitions. Manage and oversee infrastructure contracts, particularly the Infrastructure & Service Delivery managed service provider contract. Define infrastructure resilience, backup, and recovery design requirements with business continuity, security, and delivery teams. Support disaster recovery planning and testing; review technical findings and track engineering improvements. Apply relevant site HSE requirements during infrastructure work and escalate risks. Required Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of experience in IT infrastructure management or a related field. Demonstrated ability to lead technical excellence through standards, solution design, and engineering. Experience in managing infrastructure for networks, systems, datacenters, and databases. Proficiency in developing infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps. Experience with contract strategy, governance, administration, and compliance in an IT context. Familiarity with assessing emerging technologies and recommending designs. Strong understanding of commercial and cost management related to IT infrastructure. Knowledge of risk management, HSE requirements, and business continuity planning for infrastructure. Success Factors Success in this role is measured by infrastructure designs meeting agreed standards and business requirements, with documented handovers enabling effective support. Roadmaps should address capacity, lifecycle, and resilience needs. Technical assurance findings must be resolved or formally escalated, recurring issues should inform engineering improvements, and delivery teams should be able to reuse documented designs and procedures. Agreed performance targets through established management processes are also key indicators of success. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic IT environment, collaborating with various internal teams such as IT Services Delivery, PMO, Procurement, and Legal, as well as external suppliers and stakeholders.

7d2316072ebd95ab.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Guard to join their team in Al Madinah, specifically covering locations in Al Ula and Medina. This full-time role is essential for maintaining security and controlling access at industrial plants, warehouses, and other company properties. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Job Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to provide comprehensive security for the entrance gates of industrial plants, grounds, warehouses, or other company properties. The Guard will also be responsible for controlling traffic entry and departure to ensure the safety and security of all premises. Key Responsibilities Patrolling and monitoring activities on company premises regularly to deter unauthorized access and ensure a safe and secure environment. Controlling the entrance and departure of employees, visitors, and vehicles in strict adherence to established protocols. Monitoring surveillance cameras to identify and address any disruptions or unlawful activities promptly. Verifying material delivery notes, asset transfer notes, and release requests to ensure accuracy and compliance. Role Accountabilities HR Proficiency: Communicate effectively with peers and supervisors, demonstrating openness to directions and feedback. Delivery: Utilize tools and machinery efficiently, managing costs and time effectively, and executing operational activities according to delivery schedules and work instructions. Problem-Solving: Assist in resolving any related issues that arise and escalate complex operational problems as needed. Quality: Implement quality standards for products, processes, and related activities. Business Process: Execute tasks in accordance with established work routines and instructions. Compliance: Adhere to all relevant policies, procedures, and processes. Health, Safety, and Environment: Comply with all safety procedures and regulations. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a security or guarding role, preferably within an industrial or corporate setting. A strong understanding of security protocols and surveillance systems is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Madinah, with responsibilities spanning locations in Al Ula and Medina. The role requires consistent presence and vigilance to ensure continuous security coverage.

7d343a2a69cd4e1e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث أكاديمية الجزيرة العالمية عن محاضر بدوام كامل للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة حفر الباطن. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم تعليم عالي الجودة للطلاب، وتقييم أدائهم، والمساهمة في الأنشطة البحثية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التدريس أو البحث الأكاديمي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدريس المسارات التخصصية لطلبة التعليم العالي. تقييم أداء الطلبة وتحصيلهم بشكل دوري. إجراء البحوث والدراسات المتخصصة في مجال الاختصاص. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بتقدم الطلبة. إعداد خطط الدروس النظرية وتطويرها. تصميم واختيار واستخدام التقنيات التعليمية الفعالة. اختيار أساليب وطرق تدريس المادة النظرية للمسار. تقديم المحاضرات في مجال التخصص. المشاركة الفعالة في تنفيذ خطة الدراسات والأبحاث. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التدريس الأكاديمي أو البحث العلمي. القدرة على تدريس مسارات تخصصية لطلبة التعليم العالي. مهارات ممتازة في تقييم أداء الطلبة وتقديم التغذية الراجعة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات بحثية قوية والقدرة على إجراء دراسات متخصصة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الأكاديمية. إتقان تصميم واختيار واستخدام التقنيات التعليمية الحديثة. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة لتقديم المحاضرات بفعالية. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاضر ضمن بيئة أكاديمية ديناميكية في أكاديمية الجزيرة العالمية، حيث يساهم في تطوير العملية التعليمية والبحثية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة حفر الباطن بالمنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

7db0ab9ccec58577.job_title: Director of Sales - Global Sales Office KSA
7db0ab9ccec58577.description: About the Role Rotana is looking for an accomplished Director of Sales to join our Global Sales Office in Saudi Arabia, reporting to the Corporate Vice President – Global Sales. This is a senior commercial role responsible for developing and growing Rotana’s portfolio of key accounts across Corporate, MICE and strategic travel partners, with a strong focus on the Saudi market and its growing influence across regional and international travel. The successful candidate will combine strong relationships within the Kingdom with strategic commercial thinking, using their network, market knowledge and influence to generate new opportunities, strengthen existing partnerships and drive profitable revenue across Rotana’s portfolio of hotels and resorts. Your Role As Director of Sales, you will: Develop and execute the sales strategy for key global and Saudi-based accounts, aligned with Rotana’s commercial objectives. Build and manage senior-level relationships with major corporations, government and semi-government entities, travel partners, procurement leaders and key decision-makers. Grow revenue and market share across Corporate, MICE and strategic travel segments. Identify new accounts, partnerships and business opportunities within Saudi Arabia and relevant international source markets. Lead commercial negotiations covering global agreements, pricing, volume commitments and business terms. Work closely with Revenue Management and Distribution teams to protect rate integrity, profitability and appropriate pricing strategies. Partner with Rotana hotels and regional sales teams to convert opportunities and ensure effective execution of global account strategies. Maintain a deep understanding of account structures, travel programmes, decision-making processes and future business potential. Represent Rotana at key industry events, trade shows, sales missions, client engagements and roadshows. Monitor market trends, competitor activity and changing corporate and MICE travel patterns. Ensure accurate management of accounts, opportunities, activities, contracts and pipelines through Thynk CRM. Use commercial data and account insights to forecast performance, evaluate opportunities and drive continued account growth. Act as a senior ambassador for Rotana, ensuring collaborative and transparent relationships between the Global Sales Office, hotels and business partners. What We Are Looking For You will be an experienced hospitality or travel sales leader with a strong commercial network and the credibility to engage confidently with senior decision-makers. You should bring: Significant senior-level experience in hotel sales, global sales, key account management or business development. Strong knowledge of the Saudi Arabian corporate, MICE and travel market. An established network of key corporate and industry relationships within the Kingdom. Proven success in developing major accounts and delivering sustainable revenue growth. Strong commercial negotiation and strategic account-management capabilities. Experience working across multiple hotels, markets or geographic regions. Strong understanding of hotel pricing, revenue management and distribution principles. Experience with CRM-driven sales management; knowledge of Thynk would be an advantage. Excellent presentation, communication and influencing skills. The ability to work effectively across different cultures, markets and stakeholder groups. Fluency in Arabic and English is essential. A high level of integrity, commercial awareness and professional judgement.

7da6d4d154d797e9.description: About Almarai Almarai Company, established in 1977, is recognized as the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy company and a prominent food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in the MENA region. Headquartered in Riyadh, Almarai is ranked as the number one FMCG Brand in the MENA region and holds a market leadership position across its categories in the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. The company has consistently provided nutritious products for over five decades, guided by its principle: “Quality you can trust.” Almarai's product portfolio includes dairy products, juices, beverages, baked goods, poultry, infant formula, dates, fish, seafood, and bottled water, marketed under more than 20 brands such as Almarai, L’usine, 7DAYS, ALYOUM, Nuralac, and others. The company employs over 43,000 professionals across the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. In 2025, Almarai reported a net income of SAR billion on sales of SAR 22 billion. Role Summary Almarai is seeking a Pre Sell Salesman to join its team in Khamis Mushait, 'Asir, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role supports the sales department by fostering strong business relationships with customers and facilitating product listings, price changes, and updates. The Pre Sell Salesman is responsible for selling approved promotions and, under management instruction, negotiating retailer-specific promotions as agreed upon. Key Responsibilities Ensure all company products are listed in assigned accounts. Plan promotional products by account name and ensure they are listed before launch. Experience supporting new product launches, greenfield manufacturing, safe launch, or high-volume production ramp-up.
